data.one_liner: In-place substitute for Flutter's DataTable and PaginatedDataTable with sticky headers.
data.what_it_does: Provides DataTable2, PaginatedDataTable2, and AsyncPaginatedDataTable2 widgets as drop-in substitutes for stock Flutter tables. Adds support for fixed/sticky headers and columns, fixed column widths, scrollbars, and asynchronous data sources.
use_when: You need fixed or sticky header and column support in Flutter tables.
You want a drop-in replacement for stock DataTable and PaginatedDataTable widgets.
You need to display large or asynchronous datasets efficiently with paginated or async table variants.
avoid_when: You need cell content auto-sizing based on contents.
You require expanding/collapsing rows, cell merging (colspan/rowspan), or manual column/row resizing.
You are using stock Material imports without the material_ui package dependency for version 3.x.
strengths: Supports sticky top rows and left columns.
API mimics stock Flutter DataTable and PaginatedDataTable for easy migration.
Includes async paginated data source support and flexible column width controls.
weaknesses: Does not support auto-sizing cells to fit contents or row expanding/collapsing.
Requires the standalone material_ui package in version 3.x, which can conflict with standard Flutter Material imports.
Hover effects on rows do not highlight the entire row when left columns are fixed.
data.setup_notes: Add material_ui and data_table_2 to pubspec.yaml and update Material imports to use material_ui.
data.minimal_example:
Padding(
  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
  child: DataTable2(
      columnSpacing: 12,
      horizontalMargin: 12,
      minWidth: 600,
      columns: [
        DataColumn2(
          label: Text('Column A'),
          size: ColumnSize.L,
        ),
        DataColumn(
          label: Text('Column B'),
        ),
      ],
      rows: List<DataRow>.generate(
          10,
          (index) => DataRow(cells: [
                DataCell(Text('A$index')),
                DataCell(Text('B$index')),
              ]))),
)
